verdict.line: You lose if you facecheck a brush or trade in close when his Cryptic Gaze is up; you win if you poke from outside 550 range and all-in the moment that stun is on cooldown.

brief.thesis: Sion's E (Enrage) has no cooldown and lets him trade AD for health freely while permanently growing his max HP on every kill, so an unpunished Sion snowballs into a bigger threat purely off CS and takedowns. Gangplank's whole kit outranges that pattern — Parrrley hits at 625 against Cryptic Gaze's 550 — but only if you respect the stun instead of walking into it, which is exactly where OP.GG's 43.1% head-to-head (versus Gangplank's 50.2% overall baseline) says most games are actually lost.

theirWindow.when: His Q is up, you're near a brush
theirWindow.what: Cryptic Gaze stuns and deals damage at 550 range, and a fully charged version from inside brush catches people who poke on autopilot. Back off to 625 range and only auto/Parrrley when you can see he's committed Q elsewhere or it's already down.

yourWindow.when: He just landed or whiffed his Q
yourWindow.what: Cryptic Gaze is locked out for 12/11/10/9/8s by rank, so this is your all-in window. Pop E (Raise Morale) for the AD/MS buff and chain Parrrley into autos — he has no stun to punish you back with.

start.why: 49.4% win rate over 166 games and the standard 67.8% pick — the extra AD and sustain let you trade autos into his poison stacks without losing the lane to attrition.

boots.why: 55.7% win rate over 70 games — the lifesteal directly offsets the health he burns off you with empowered Enrage autos during extended trades.

core.why: Mana sustain to spam Parrrley (5s cooldown) every wave without running dry, which is the entire basis of your poke advantage over his 550-range Q.
Part of the 50% win rate, 30-game core path — the execute threshold closes out trades he tries to sustain through with his E health-for-AD toggle.
Armor penetration cuts through the max HP he's been stacking for free off every kill, keeping your Parrrley poke relevant into the late game.

situational.when: he leans on detonating Death's Caress (W) as a damage shield every trade
you need a lifeline against his Cannibalism (R) lifesteal in prolonged skirmishes
the game goes long and you need raw crit damage to break through his stacked HP

runes.keystoneWhy: The 26.2% pick rate page at 45.3% win rate — the added DoT stacks on top of your Grog-Soaked Blade poison every time you land a Parrrley, which is how you out-damage his free health-for-AD trades.

summoners.why: 78.2% pick rate at 46.8% win rate — Ignite punishes the moment you catch him over-extended on Enrage health loss, and since his Q stun is his only real engage, Flash lets you either dodge it or close distance to force your all-in window.

playing.title: Poke from 625, not 550
playing.detail: Parrrley outranges Cryptic Gaze by 75 units. Land it and walk the auto back out instead of standing in his stun range to confirm the hit.

playing.title: Never facecheck his brush
playing.detail: OP.GG's own read on this matchup is to respect a fully charged Q from inside a bush — treat every brush near his stun range as a live threat, especially once his Q cooldown drops to 10s at level 3.

playing.title: All-in only when his Q is down
playing.detail: After he lands or whiffs Cryptic Gaze it's locked out for 12-8s by rank. That's your window to commit — pop Raise Morale (E) for the AD/MS buff and chain autos.

playing.title: Punish his Enrage health loss
playing.detail: Enrage has no cooldown but drains his own HP per empowered auto. If he's been toggling it to trade, your poke finishes what he already started on himself.

playing.title: Hold Remove Scurvy for his stun
playing.detail: W clears Cryptic Gaze's stun and heals you. Don't burn it on chip damage — save it for the moment he commits the engage.

playing.title: Freeze waves to deny his HP stacking
playing.detail: Sion gains permanent max HP from every kill, minions included, while Enraged. Tighten the wave so he can't farm free stats off cannon minions.

playing.title: Use Cannon Barrage to zone, not just burst
playing.detail: R's global range is better spent denying his farm or split-push than as a finishing tool — he can tank the DoT, but losing CS to it compounds his lack of HP growth.

brief.patchCaveat: Every item, rune, and summoner spell above comes from OP.GG's measured Gangplank-vs-Sion games on the current patch (16.20.1) — the win rates and pick rates are real sample data, not estimates. The matchup reading — why the stun range matters, when to all-in, how his E snowballs — is coaching judgment built on top of those numbers.

stats.opponentTip: Pressure lane during early game for control but always be wary of (Q). Always be careful of his fully charged (Q) used from inside a brush.
